source_text: Misit et vocavit Barac: Vade in montem Thabor. Si veneris mecum vadam — fides mulieris corroborat ducem.
pass_a_gloss: She-sent and called Barak: Go into mountain Tabor. If you-come with-me I-will-go — faith of-woman strengthens leader.
pass_b_english: [[She sent and called Barak: Go to Mount Tabor >> Bible:Judges 4:6-8]]. If you go with me I will go — a woman’s faith strengthens the leader.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
